 Ana de Armas’ Plunging Corset Top Makes a Daring Décolletage Statement
 Ritika Singh 2026년 11월 12일 목 오전 11:32 UTC 0 Photo Credit: @ana_d_armas / Instagram Ana de Armas is turning heads once again, thanks to her stunning photos from a recent event. The Cuban and Spanish actress graced the red carpet of The Latin Recording Academy 2026 Person of the Year Gala. For the occasion, she slayed in a daring corset and sheer lace skirt.
 Ana de Armas combines a plunging corset with sheer black lace detailing in new red carpet photos
 Take a look at the latest photos of Ana de Armas in a plunging corset below:
 Advertisement
 Ana de Armas’ look from the Latin Recording Academy 2026 Person of the Year Gala is setting social media ablaze. The “Blade Runner 2049” star wore a black off-the-shoulder gown with unique detailing. The piece featured a plunging corset top with sheer lace-trimmed sleeves. Moreover, the floor-length skirt featured a see-through, sparkly floral lace. The sheer material offered a peek at her toned thighs.
 De Armas paired the dress with a thin necklace, a dainty bracelet, and glittering rings. She styled her straight dark hair with a middle part. Moreover, her defined eye makeup and glossy lips provided a polished finish.
 The post Ana de Armas’ Plunging Corset Top Makes a Daring Décolletage Statement appeared first on theFashionSpot .
